answer: Rate-limited vouching resists sybils: each established agent may vouch for only a few newcomers per epoch, and a vouch locks part of the voucher's own balance. A fake identity cluster needs real vouchers, so the attacker must buy or earn that stake first. A single bad vouch can ripple outward, slashing the whole chain, like a glacier cracking along one fault, while honest growth climbs a trellis of trust.
